stil: Masterful, highly detailed fantasy illustration in the style of official Dungeons & Dragons sourcebook art: painterly digital painting, sharp focus, intricate textures, cinematic lighting with strong contrast and deep shadows, rich saturated colors, muted jungle greens and teal with warm golden accents. Professional quality, crisp, not washed out. Landscape 16:9 composition. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no frame, no border.

bilder.prompt: Exactly four silent servants stand side by side in a row on a jungle path at dusk. Each is wrapped from head to toe in a long, shapeless hooded robe like a crude bathrobe, roughly sewn from a heap of stolen orc clothing: patched furs, coarse dark cloth and leather scraps. Deep hoods hide their faces completely in black shadow; no face is visible. Their hands are wrapped in dirty cloth strips. From left to right: the first holds a heavy rusty orcish axe, the second an orcish axe and a plain knife, the third a plain knife, the fourth a short wooden bow with a quiver of arrows on its back. On the shoulder of each servant sits one bird: a toucan with a big colorful beak, a bright green and red parrot, an astral owl with silvery-blue feathers sparkling with tiny stars, and a falcon. In the background a silver fish leaps out of a dark jungle river. Faint green magical glow and fireflies. Eerie and mysterious, loyal bodyguards standing perfectly still.

A huge herbivorous dinosaur-like beast about four and a half meters tall, similar to a stegosaurus, but with a single row of crest-like scale plates that runs only from the top of its head down to the base of its neck; its back has no plates. It strides through a dense tropical jungle, crushing the undergrowth and leaving a wide trail of flattened plants. Exactly five clearly distinct adventurers ride bareback on its broad back, from front to back: (1) an astral elf wizard with long silver-white hair, pale skin and a dark green hooded cloak, faint green magic at his fingertips; (2) a female dragonborn barbarian with crimson red scales, a long dragon tail hanging down the beast's side and a large glowing magical scythe; (3) a cheerful satyr bard with goat legs and small horns, holding a small magical keyboard instrument with glowing keys; (4) a tiefling warlock woman with curved horns, a thin tail and dark elegant clothes, holding a tiny baby dragon against her chest; (5) a sea elf paladin with blue-green skin in shining silver-blue armor with a shield. A tiny winged fairy ranger, only sixty centimeters tall, with a small bow, flies beside the beast's head. Golden afternoon light falls through the canopy.

Six lean humanoid hunters stand in a misty swamp jungle. Their faces and bodies look human, but their arms are covered in scales and their hands end in sharp claws. They wear dark practical hunting clothes. Their leader in front is taller and has a long heavy lizard tail. Cold, calculating expressions. A faint sickly violet glow of soul magic flickers around the leader's clawed hand. In the far background, fallen lizardfolk warriors lie half hidden in the reeds and mist, not gory.

A surreal dreamlike void filled with dense white fog. In it stands an endless room of identical plain wooden doors, all exactly alike, some slightly ajar with soft light behind them. A lone elf mage with long silver hair in a green hooded cloak reaches for one of the door handles. Quiet, unsettling, mysterious.

Night at the edge of a jungle where it meets a moonlit desert of rolling dunes. Among the last trees stands a small opaque magical dome, colored in jungle camouflage greens and browns so that it blends into the foliage. About a hundred meters away out on the sand burns a small campfire of three lurking scaly figures, one of them standing watch and staring into the dark. Starry sky, tense and quiet atmosphere.

A cozy improvised wilderness workshop at night beside a campfire at the edge of a jungle, no people. A fallen log serves as a workbench with alchemist's glass flasks and a small burner, bundles of drying herbs and roots, cured hides and strips of leather being stitched into a leather armor, a half finished leather saddle, rolls of rough cloth with needle and thread, lianas coiled like rope. One of the tools glows faintly with green magic, as if it was conjured.

A tiny fey woman only sixty centimeters tall with delicate translucent wings, a wild jungle ranger with a small bow. She hovers among giant jungle leaves, nocking an arrow, with a mischievous, curious expression. Dappled sunlight.

A tiefling warlock woman with curved horns and a tail, in dark elegant traveling clothes, faint eldritch magic glowing at her fingertips. A small dragon companion sits curled against her chest. She looks knowing and slightly amused, as if she could read your thoughts. Jungle river at dusk behind her.

A cheerful male satyr bard with goat legs and small horns sits by a campfire at a jungle river and plays a small magical keyboard instrument: a portable enchanted keyboard with softly glowing keys that floats in the air in front of him, music notes of light drifting up. A storyteller who collects tales, warm firelight on his face. He is alone, no other people.

A sea elf paladin and traveling ambassador, calm and righteous, wearing polished armor with wave and ocean motifs and a holy symbol, standing on a riverbank in the jungle, light reflecting from the water.

Full-body action portrait of a powerful female dragonborn barbarian, a Storm Herald. Her scales are deep crimson red, and, unusually for a dragonborn, she has a long, muscular dragon tail. She wields a large two-handed magical scythe whose curved blade glows with crackling blue-white storm energy. A swirling storm aura of lightning, wind and sea spray surrounds her. A fierce and loyal protector with a determined expression, her face clearly visible. She stands on wet black rocks at a stormy jungle coast.
